keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «많은 백성이 한자를 읽지 못해서 왕이 모두를 위한 쉬운 글자를 만들고 싶어 했다(이유)» 와 «한글은 모두를 위해 사랑으로 만든 선물이었다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the reason (many people could not read Chinese characters, so the king wanted easy letters for everyone) and the lesson (Hangeul was a gift made with love for everyone). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Hayun traveled back to 1443 and saw King Sejong making Hangeul.
Hangeul was a gift made with love for everyone.

sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why did King Sejong want to make new letters?
qs.qko: 세종대왕은 왜 새 글자를 만들고 싶어 했나요?
opts: Many people could not read Chinese characters.
He wanted a secret code for the palace.
Hayun asked him to make them.
evs: A kind man in a red robe was writing strange shapes on paper.
"Many people cannot read Chinese characters," he said. "I want easy letters for everyone."
The king smiled, and then everything went white.
Hayun found an old gold watch in Grandpa's drawer.
why: 왕은 «많은 백성이 한자를 읽지 못한단다. 모두를 위한 쉬운 글자를 만들고 싶구나»라고 말했어요. 비밀 암호나 하윤이의 부탁 이야기는 없어요.
The king said many people could not read Chinese characters, and he wanted easy letters for everyone. Nothing says it was a secret code or that Hayun asked him.

qs.q: The story says, "Just then, the watch shook. It was taking her home!" What does "taking her home" mean here?
qs.qko: "Just then, the watch shook. It was taking her home!"라는 문장이 있어요. 여기서 "taking her home"은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: bringing her back to her own time and room
taking her to the king's house
making her stay in the palace
evs: Hayun was back in her room.
Suddenly, she was standing in a palace in the year 1443!
It was King Sejong, and he looked very tired.
Hayun looked at the shapes. They were the first Hangeul letters!
why: 곧이어 «하윤이는 자기 방으로 돌아와 있었다»라고 나와요. 시계가 하윤이를 원래 시간, 자기 방으로 데려간 거예요.
Right after, the story says, «Hayun was back in her room.» The watch brought her back to her own time and her own room.

qs.q: What were the strange shapes the king was writing?
qs.qko: 왕이 종이에 쓰던 이상한 모양은 무엇이었나요?
opts: They were the first Hangeul letters.
They were pictures of the palace.
They were numbers for a math test.
evs: A kind man in a red robe was writing strange shapes on paper.
She turned its knob, and the room began to spin.
Hayun looked at the shapes. They were the first Hangeul letters!
Now, when she writes Hangeul, she remembers the tired king.
why: 왕은 종이에 이상한 모양을 쓰고 있었고, 하윤이가 보니 그것이 처음 만들어진 한글이었어요. 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
The king was writing strange shapes on paper, and Hayun saw they were the first Hangeul letters. Put these two sentences together to find the answer.

ends: Hayun turns the knob again and visits another time in history.
하윤이가 손잡이를 다시 돌려 역사 속 다른 시대로 가요.
Hayun teaches her little brother to write his first Hangeul letters.
하윤이가 남동생에게 처음으로 한글 쓰는 법을 가르쳐 줘요.

write.src: “I want to <u>meet King Sejong</u> because <u>he made Hangeul for everyone</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.

chips.b: I want to see the sea
chips.label: Jeju

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «I want to» 뒤에는 동사(meet, visit)를 바로 쓰고, «because» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을» 을 쓰세요.
write.moreEn: One more step: after «I want to», write a verb (meet, visit). After «because», write who + what.

img.cover: In a candlelit palace room long ago, a nine-year-old Korean girl with long straight black hair, a pink hairband and a light blue sweater stands beside a low wooden desk holding a glowing old gold watch, while a kind man with a short black beard, a long red royal robe with a round gold dragon pattern on the chest and a black royal hat smiles at her and holds a brush over a sheet of blank paper.

scenes.1: In a quiet palace room at night, a nine-year-old Korean girl with long straight black hair, a pink hairband and a light blue sweater peeks out from behind a painted wooden screen at a kind man with a short black beard, a long red royal robe with a round gold dragon pattern on the chest and a black royal hat, who sits at a low desk with stacks of blank paper and rubs his tired eyes by the light of a single candle.
scenes.3: Back in her cozy bedroom at night, a nine-year-old Korean girl with long straight black hair, a pink hairband and a light blue sweater sits at her desk with a pencil and a closed notebook, smiling softly, while the old gold watch lies beside her desk lamp.
